title: From EHR chaos to clinical clarity: enhancing foundational encoders with task-specific attention for domain-oriented representation learning in downstream clinical applications

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《From EHR chaos to clinical clarity: enhancing foundational encoders with task-specific attention for domain-oriented representation learning in downstream clinical applications》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Electronic health records (EHRs) contain rich clinical information; however, they pose challenges for representation learning due to long free-text notes, domain shift, irregular structure, incomplete, and sparse fields.

evidence.text: Electronic health records (EHRs) contain rich clinical information; however, they pose challenges for representation learning due to long free-text notes, domain shift, irregular structure, incomplete, and sparse fields.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《From EHR chaos to clinical clarity: enhancing foundational encoders with task-specific attention for domain-oriented representation learning in downstream clinical applications》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Clustering quality increases across ARI, homogeneity, completeness, and V-measure, indicating more coherent patient strata.

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】Overall, our framework produces portable, interpretable patient embeddings that may help in various downstream analytics and decision support in real-world clinical settings.

evidence.text: Clustering quality increases across ARI, homogeneity, completeness, and V-measure, indicating more coherent patient strata.
Overall, our framework produces portable, interpretable patient embeddings that may help in various downstream analytics and decision support in real-world clinical settings.
